description:
¡Hola a todos! 🚀

Somos un equipo llamado "ÓRBITA ARTEMIS" con integrantes enfocado en el desafío Guía de supervivencia interplanetaria: mapa marciano. Nuestro objetivo es desarrollar una plataforma web interactiva y en capas que combine datos satélites y de rovers de la NASA para ayudar a los futuros exploradores a planificar rutas y caminatas seguras en Marte, por esta razón nació "ÓRBITA 360°" la app que será tú gps en Marte.
summary:
We developed ÓRBITA 360°, a website featuring an interactive map of Mars designed to help astronauts plan their walks. They can choose a scientific destination, such as the grid areas of Mount Sharp, and explore different layers showing topography, geology, temperature, radiation, and potential route hazards.

We address this challenge by bringing together everything needed for safer exploration in one view. The tool plots a route that avoids steep slopes, rocks, dust storms, and high-radiation areas, and compares it with the most direct path. It also offers a first-person view, an atlas featuring landing sites from NASA missions, and games to practice survival skills.

This project is important because astronaut safety is NASA's highest priority. Our prototype uses simulated data inspired by Gale Crater. The next step is to connect it to real data sources such as Mars Trek, MOLA, and the data and examples provided by the NASA Space Apps website.
details: ÓRBITA 360° started with a question: If an astronaut walks on Mars, where should they go? Our proposal is an interactive map where users can choose a scientific destination and explore, layer by layer, the terrain, geology, temperature, radiation, and potential route hazards. The platform calculates the safest route and compares it with the most direct one, allowing every step to be planned using clear information. Users can also explore the route from a first-person perspective, discover an atlas featuring NASA landing sites, and practice through survival missions and games. The platform is available in both Spanish and English and includes a dynamic user profile. We developed this project with the support of AI tools such as AI Studio, ChatGPT, v0 by Vercel, Google Gemini, and Claude (Anthropic AI), which helped us with programming, writing, and building the website. This is a prototype based on simulated data inspired by Gale Crater. Our next step is to connect it to real NASA data sources, such as Mars Trek and MOLA.
